sources.airportT: Wikipedia "List of busiest airports by cargo traffic" (ACI figures; 2025 preliminary top 10, older years for LAX 2023 and DWC 2015) and, for the rest, the cargo figure in each airport's Wikipedia infobox (mostly 2024-2025; Indian airports are FY Apr 2025-Mar 2026). US short tons and lbs converted to tonnes. Approximate; see README for per-airport years.
sources.exportIndex: Air-cargo export strength around 1.0. >1 = net exporter by air (Asia manufacturing/e-commerce: CN, HK, TW, KR, VN; perishables: KE, CO, EC, CL, PE, NO; pharma/high-value: CH, IE, BE, DE, SG). <1 = net importer by air (US, GB, AU, Gulf states, SA). Values are a SkyEmpire estimate from the direction of the main air-cargo trade lanes (Asia->North America and Asia->Europe headhaul, Latin American and African perishables northbound) reported by IATA/ACI; not a published index. Gulf hubs (AE, QA) are mostly transit, so near 1. Any country not listed = 1.0.
sources.hubs2023: MEM, ANC, SDF, CVG: approximate 2023 annual cargo tonnes from Wikipedia airport pages (added with the cargo hubs).
